name: Booming Blade
desc: You make a melee weapon attack against a creature within 5 feet. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon's normal effects, and starting at level 5 it takes an extra 1d8 Thunder damage (2d8 at level 11). If the target willingly moves before the start of your next turn, it takes extra Thunder damage: 1d8 (2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11).
